items.title: Labor takes a stand on data centre rules and AI copyright
items.description: The prime minister has unveiled Labor's plan for new AI national standards, warning Australia has a narrow window to set AI's "social licence". A new set of standards for artificial intelligence will provide clear rules for data centres, forcing them to minimise water usage and underwrite or supply their own power. Anthony Albanese has vowed AI companies will not be able to use Australian books, music, art or news to train AI "without the artist's control".

items.title: GP clinic network hit by major cyber breach
items.description: Partnered Health, which operates more than 50 general practice and skin cancer clinics across Australia, has identified more than a dozen clinics where it fears patient information was taken.

items.title: Sydney uni chief regrets handling of pro-Palestinian encampments
items.description: A royal commission hears how both the universities of Melbourne and Sydney have improved processes for students to make complaints in the wake of antisemitic experiences by staff and students, which escalated in 2024.

items.title: Trump beats his own record for strategic backflips on Iran
items.description: Donald Trump's actions this week have only confirmed he has run out of options and is now engaged in a simple war of wills, and calculations on who will run out of munitions first, with an enemy that he has underestimated from the start.

items.title: One-way 'speedboats with explosives' launched by US for first time
items.description: The United States is using one-way drone boats in combat against Iran for the first time in its military history. A defence expert says America is catching on to this "cheaper and more effective" tactic employed by Iran and Ukraine.

items.title: Disgraced footballer Nicky Winmar removed from AFL Hall of Fame
items.description: Winmar was found guilty earlier this month of three counts of unlawful assault and common law assault.

items.title: Police investigate attempted sexual assault of Melbourne dog walkers
items.description: Police are investigating after two women reported that a man attempted to assault them before the dogs they were walking chased him away.

items.title: An alias and a dead man's name: Former ATO executive charged with fraud
items.description: Former assistant tax commissioner Nick Petroulias has been charged with multiple fraud offences, accused of obtaining financial advantage by deception and using false documents.

items.title: Ex-Sydney church turned LGBT nightclub ordered to 'cease offensive trading'
items.description: The LGBTQIA+ venue said it was exploring its legal options after being issued with a breach of lease notice just days after opening at a former Sydney church.

items.title: ICE suspends vehicle stops after two deadly shootings
items.description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement orders its officers to suspend most vehicle stops after agents fatally shot two men six days apart during stops in Maine and Texas.

items.title: Diarrhoea-inducing Cyclospora outbreak spreads across US
items.description: The US CDC is investigating thousands of possible cases across 34 states, as officials track down the source of the outbreak.

items.title: 'They hate us and we hate them': England-Argentina semi will come with extra feeling
items.description: It is one of the biggest rivalries in men's World Cup history, and while the teams may downplay the history, England and Argentina fans are ready for another iconic showdown.

items.title: School worker on child abuse material charges denied bail
items.description: The 35-year-old woman, who is seven months' pregnant, is in custody after police discovered alleged child abuse material on her mobile phone.

items.title: Moira Deeming makes last-ditch plea to Liberal Party to retain candidacy
items.description: Victorian MP Moira Deeming faces being disendorsed as a Liberal candidate for refusing to apologise to former party leader Matthew Guy, after accusing him of assaulting her at a community event in May.

items.title: The bittersweet reality of becoming an empty-nester
items.description: Experts say there can be unexpected grief for parents that comes from children leaving home.

items.title: Monet, Renoir, van Gogh masterpieces appear in two new blockbuster exhibitions
items.description: More than 150 years after the first Impressionist exhibition in Paris, the Art Gallery of South Australia and Geelong Gallery cast new light on the influential art movement.

items.title: Quiz: Dust off your passport and join us on a trip
items.description: Which of these peaks isn't in the Himalayas? And in what country would you find the island of Rapa Nui?

items.title: Man shot dead in Sydney's north-west in 'very brazen attack'
items.description: A man has been shot dead in Sydney's north-west, with the homicide squad now leading the investigation.

items.title: Employees sue Meta over claims AI systems selected workers for lay-offs
items.description: Many of the employees in the lawsuit took pregnancy or parental leave, during which time they would not have worked and thus had their measured output reduced.

items.title: Wife recounts horror as husband sucked out of Ryanair plane window
items.description: A woman describes hearing a bang before seeing her husband almost get sucked into space during a flight from Greece to Germany.

items.title: Plumber takes down alleged car thief in viral video, but lawyer warns of risk
items.description: A Perth plumber has gone viral on social media after chasing down and restraining an alleged car thief after a botched getaway, but a prominent lawyer warns citizens' arrests are risky.

items.title: Primary teacher played kissing game with student, jury hears
items.description: Former Gippsland teacher stands trial over continued sexual abuse of primary school student in the 90s

items.title: New Zealand reports first H5N1 bird flu case
items.description: The deadly virus was detected in a brown skua seabird near Wellington, although authorities say there is not yet any evidence of mass mortality or impacts on poultry.

items.title: Timor-Leste scam centre compounds uncovered as police make 300 arrests
items.description: Police in Timor-Leste uncover a major international scam centre in the country, arresting more than 300 Chinese, Indonesian and Cambodian nationals in raids across the capital, Dili.

items.title: Boy, 5, dies after being hit by 4WD in suburban Perth
items.description: A five-year-old boy dies and a 48-year-old woman is critically injured after being struck by a four-wheel drive outside a park in Cloverdale in Perth's south-east,
